findings.note: Dated Nov 28: Norman Powell (hamstring) is out against Indiana. Okoro is named as a candidate for more minutes, and he has averaged 11.4 points in 31.0 minutes over his last five games, which is above 10.5.

Nov 27 Pacers preview lists Okoro as a probable Bulls starter next to Giddey, Hield, Buzelis and Claxton. Indiana (6-13) is playing the second night of a back-to-back after losing 111-87 to Philadelphia.

RotoWire scored his last game at 10 points in 31 minutes, his ninth straight start. It describes his offensive usage as modest, so his scoring depends mostly on how many minutes he plays. The NBA.com page lists his season average at 7.8 PPG.
